name: 95113 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95113 (San Jose) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95113 (San Jose) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
61% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95113 (San Jose) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 19.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 72% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
